root_cause.text: The tunnel xmit functions (iptunnel_xmit and ip6tunnel_xmit) lacked a dedicated recursion limit, enabling infinite recursive loops when bond broadcast traffic is forwarded through GRE tunnels that route back through the same bond, causing a kernel stack overflow.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Tunnel xmit functions (iptunnel_xmit, ip6tunnel_xmit) lack their own recursion limit. When a bond device in broadcast mode has GRE tap interfaces as slaves, and those GRE tunnels route back through the bond, multicast/broadcast traffic triggers infinite recursion between bond_xmit_broadcast() and ip_tunnel_xmit()/ip6_tnl_xmit(), causing kernel stack overflow." The patch adds recursion detection with a new limit (IP_TUNNEL_RECURSION_LIMIT=4) inside iptunnel_xmit and ip6tunnel_xmit, and the provided KASAN stack trace shows repeated cycles of these functions.
